text:
anna: Heads-up — our weekly RFC/design sync (Weds 09:00 PST / 17:00 CET) seems to have the wrong timezone on the recurring invite. Zoom link changed this morning.
sam: saw it. My calendar shows it at 16:00 CET though? DST weirdness?
jun: I got a notification that the recurring series was edited by mike@redwood.com and the new recurring Zoom uses a new meeting id.
rachel: confirmed — the original series had timezone set to floating. When DST kicked in it shifted. Noticed link: https://zoom.us/j/1112223333
anna: oh no. That explains people turning up an hour early.
mike: FYI I updated the meeting because host account hit license limit. Didn't realize the series timezone was floating. Will revert.
sam: can we instead set the calendar event timezone explicitly to America/Los_Angeles and update the series? Floating is the culprit.
jun: also need to reissue invites — Google Calendar sometimes keeps old copies. Recommend canceling the series and creating a new one with fixed timezone and "use same meeting id" option.
rachel: @mike can you create the new series and paste the new link here? I'll scrub existing invites for attendees.
mike: will do in 15m. new link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=secure
anna: thanks. Quick ask — can we add an agenda item to the new series: RFC review (runtime cache change), 20m; triage, 10m; AOB, 5m
sam: added a calendar description note with agenda and PR links: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/424
jun: note for those on IST: confirm whether 9:00 PST is 22:30 IST — I can rotate the meeting if regular attendees in APAC prefer.
rachel: APAC folks: please react with :+1: if current time works, otherwise propose alternatives.
calendar-bot: poll created: https://polls.redwood.com/s/meet-time — options: Wed 09:00 PT / Wed 20:00 PT
mike: I've canceled the old series and sent invites for the new fixed-time event. If you still have stale invites, delete them and accept the new one.
anna: awesome, will confirm attendee list and sticky agenda. Thanks all :tada:
